column1: Who handles operating-system and database-engine patching for Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance?
column2:
Microsoft.
These managed services reduce infrastructure-maintenance work.
Review source

column1: What database-design work remains your responsibility in Azure SQL Database?
column2:
Designing application objects such as tables, indexes, and constraints.
Managed infrastructure does not replace application-specific database design.
Review source

column1: Which Azure SQL Database service tier separates compute from scalable storage for very large databases?
column2:
Hyperscale.
Its architecture allows storage to grow independently of compute.
Review source

column1: How does Azure SQL Database Hyperscale scale out read workloads?
column2:
By adding read-only replicas.
Route suitable read workloads to replicas instead of the primary.
Review source

column1: Which Azure SQL Database compute tier automatically scales compute within configured limits as demand changes?
column2:
Serverless.
The service adjusts compute rather than requiring each capacity change to be manual.
Review source

column1: What database resource remains billed while an Azure SQL Database serverless database is paused?
column2:
Storage.
Compute charges stop during the paused period.
Review source

column1: Why must applications use connection retries when accessing an automatically paused serverless database?
column2:
Resuming the database can cause temporary connection failures.
A retry allows the application to recover after the database resumes.
Review source

column1: Which Azure SQL Database feature can create workload-based indexes when its CREATE_INDEX option is enabled?
column2:
Automatic tuning.
It evaluates the effect of automatically applied index changes.
Review source

column1: How does automatic plan correction respond to a query-plan regression?
column2:
It forces the last known good execution plan.
This is a plan-selection action, not automatic index creation.
Review source

column1: Which Azure managed service targets near-complete SQL Server instance-level feature compatibility?
column2:
Azure SQL Managed Instance.
Some features depend on its update policy, so compatibility does not mean that every instance has every latest feature.
Review source

column1: Which built-in service schedules database jobs in Azure SQL Managed Instance?
column2:
SQL Server Agent.
Managed Instance supports instance-level job scheduling.
Review source

column1: What naming format references an object in another database on the same Azure SQL Managed Instance?
column2:
database.schema.object.
Three-part names support cross-database queries within the instance.
Review source

column1: Which feature continuously replicates SQL Server data to Azure SQL Managed Instance for hybrid or migration use?
column2:
Managed Instance link.
It uses distributed availability groups for near-real-time replication.
Review source

column1: Which Azure SQL deployment option gives you direct control over the underlying operating system?
column2:
SQL Server on Azure Virtual Machines.
This option also gives control over the SQL Server installation and configuration.
Review source

column1: Which extension adds Azure portal management and backup or patching automation for SQL Server on Azure Windows VMs?
column2:
The SQL IaaS Agent extension.
Register the VM to access the extension's management features.
Review source

column1: What primary workload does SQL database in Microsoft Fabric serve?
column2:
Online transaction processing (OLTP).
It is an operational database with built-in integration into Fabric analytics.
Review source

column1: Where does SQL database in Fabric automatically mirror supported operational tables for analytics?
column2:
OneLake.
Mirroring avoids the need to build a separate extraction pipeline for those supported tables.
Review source

column1: Which Fabric SQL database endpoint provides read-only T-SQL access to mirrored analytical data?
column2:
The SQL analytics endpoint.
Read-only refers to table data, although the endpoint permits objects such as views.
Review source

column1: Which tool supports .bacpac import/export and .dacpac deployment operations for SQL database in Fabric?
column2:
SqlPackage.
It supports database portability and changes to database object definitions.
Review source

column1: Who manages built-in high availability for Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance?
column2:
Microsoft.
Unlike a self-managed SQL Server deployment, the service provides the availability infrastructure.
Review source
